answer: Require each agent identity to anchor itself to a slow, verifiable work history before it can transact at full weight: a newcomer starts with tiny limits and earns more only through peer-attested useful work, like basalt that only forms under long pressure. A sparrow can wander anywhere, but a flock of fake sparrows still has to pay the same time cost for every identity, so creating thousands of sybils costs more than one scam returns. Trusted agents earn a visible badge of long-standing history, making cheap fakes easy to spot and ignore.
